title: Stats Config
description: Configuration for /idpf-stats metric collection, label categories, test patterns, report sections, benchmark populations and DORA tiers

caveat.description: Rendered with the section heading. Carries the SPACE single-dimension warning for Activity metrics (#2676).

velocityBenchmarks.description: Comparison bands for throughput rates. EVERY set must name the population it describes and cite where its figures came from (#2676) — an uncited median reads as measured fact when it may be a guess.

population.description: Who these figures describe. Required so a reader can tell whether the comparison is meaningful for them.

source.description: Where the figures came from. An internal heuristic must say so explicitly rather than be left blank — blank reads as an oversight, 'unvalidated internal heuristic' reads as a known limitation.

validated.description: False when the figures are not derived from published research. Machine-readable so a report can label them without parsing prose.

refreshedAt.description: ISO date this set was last surveyed against its source (#2677). Staleness is measured from here, so a set that has never been surveyed must omit it rather than carry the date it was invented — an absent date reports as never-surveyed, which is true; a fabricated one reports as fresh, which is not.

doraTiers.description: Published DORA performance tiers, used to place measured DORA outputs (#2676). Carries its own provenance and a report year, because the bands shift between annual reports.

baseline.description: Trailing-baseline settings for the deviation figure that replaced the '~Nx typical developer velocity' line (#2676). The comparison is against this repository's own history, so it needs no external population.

windowDays.description: How many days of trailing history form the baseline. Stated in the report so the figure is interpretable.

minDataPoints.description: Fewer usable points than this in the window reports not-collected with a reason — never 0, and never a median computed from too little history.
